title: EstablishData
description: `establishData` is required to establish a new user authorization or to launch the Trustly UI for any other reason

paymentType.description: The Payment Type of the transaction to create. Currently only Disbursement, Deferred, and Instant are supported.

returnUrl.description: Return URL to use when the transaction is completed.

cancelUrl.description: Cancel URL to use if the user cancels the transaction.

notificationUrl.description: Notification URL to use for notifications associated with this transaction. This overrides the notification URL configured at the merchant level.

accessId.description: Your client application access id. It will be provided to you.

requestSignature.description: Request Signature that can be validated to verify the response authenticity.

merchantReference.description: An external reference from the merchant. Ex: Order identifier from merchant e-commerce application.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO Currency Code. Currently only USD is supported.

kycType.description: Specifies the KYC (Know Your Customer) type as number. The possible value is 1 (OnlineBanking). This field is optional and can only be used by merchants configured for [Trustly ID](/integrate/retrieve-data/trustly-id).

amount.description: The amount of the transaction. This represents the maximum amount of the transactions that can be processed with the Authorization. If the amount is 0.00, there will be no upper bound on the transaction. (10 characters with support for 2 decimal places)

country.description: 2-character ISO code of the country for the bank account that was selected. Currently only the US, CA, UK, DE, and AU are supported.

name.description: A description to identify a specific account (e.g. Test checking account)

type.description: See Financial Institution Account Type Values.

profile.description: See Financial Institution Account Profile Values

accountNumber.description: Bank Account Number or VAN if `virtualAccountRoutingPair` is equal to `true`.

iban.description: IBAN (International Bank Account Number) is an internationally agreed system of identifying bank accounts across national borders

verified.description: Indicates if the account is verified or not.

accountNumberLastFour.description: The last 4 digits of the real account number.

virtualAccountRoutingPair.description: Indicates if account is using virtual/tokenized account and routing numbers (VANs/TANs) or not.

AccountCountry.description: 2-character ISO code of the country for the bank account that was selected. Currently only the US, CA, UK, DE, and AU are supported.
AccountCountry.title: AccountCountry

address1.description: Address line 1 (e.g., street or PO Box)

address2.description: Address line 2 (e.g., apartment, suite or unit number)

Address.description: Valid mailing or billing address associated with the customer
Address.title: Address

taxId.description: Customer tax ID (e.g. SSN [US], SIN [CA]). *May be required depending on industry and location.*

createdAt.description: The record created date and time as a UNIX timestamp.

updatedAt.description: The record created date and time as a UNIX timestamp.

enrollDate.description: Date of the user's first transaction in your system, regardless of payment method used as a UNIX timestamp.

vip.description: Range that determines how low-risk the customer represents to the merchant

balance.description: Customer account balance (not associated with a financial institution account).

externalTier.description: It should describe the customer''s rank to the merchant (e.g. Gold, Diamond, 4 stars, etc.)

personId.description: Unique customer identity throughout different banks.

customData.description: Object for sending merchant-specific custom data.

Customer.description: The Trustly customer object, containing identification details and contact information.

verified.description: true if the account is verified; false otherwise.

type.description:
Verification Type:
 * `1`: Manual - The account was verified with manual account verification. For example, Manual Electronic Check and Micro Challenge Deposit.
 * `2`: Online Banking verification	- The Account was verified using the Trustly Online Banking application.
 * `3`: Database verification	- The Account was verified using the Trustly database or a Third-Party Service.

hasEnoughFunds.description: If true, there is enough balance in account.

verificationDate.description:
The date and time the verification was completed 
 as a UNIX timestamp.

score.description:
Verification Score:
 * `0`: Invalid input. The account or routing number are invalid. (Verified Mapping = false)
 * `1`: There is a strong indication that the account is invalid. (Verified Mapping = false)
 * `2`: There are active non-bankable returns on this account that are less than 3 years old. (Verified Mapping = false)
 * `3`: There are administrative returns on this account. (Verified Mapping = false)
 * `4`: The format appears to be suspicious. (Verified Mapping = false)
 * `5`: There is no data on this account or format. (Verified Mapping = false)
 * `6`: We have not seen this account, but the format appears to be valid. (Verified Mapping = true)
 * `7`: We have seen this account but have not received a final disposition on the transaction. (Verified Mapping = true)
 * `8`: We have seen this account, but not in the last 6 months, and have seen no returns associated with the account. (Verified Mapping = true)
 * `9`: We have seen this account in the last 6 months and have seen no returns associated with the account. (Verified Mapping = true)
 * `10`: This account has been directly validated with/by the financial institution or 3rd party. We have the highest confidence that this account is valid. (Verified Mapping = true)

thirdPartyScore.description:
Verification Third-Party Score:
 * `0`: Failed RT validation. (Verified Mapping = 0)
 * `100`: The supplier has a strong indication that this account is invalid. (Verified Mapping = 1)
 * `200`: The supplier has active non-bankable debt(s) on this account that are less than 3 years old. (Verified Mapping = 2)
 * `300`: The supplier has administrative returns on this account. (Verified Mapping = 3)
 * `400`: The supplier does not have Neg data on this account, but the format appears to be suspicious. (Verified Mapping = 4)
 * `500`: The supplier does not have data on this account or format. (Verified Mapping = 5)
 * `600`: The supplier has not seen this account, but the format appears valid. (Verified Mapping = 6)
 * `700`: The supplier has seen this account, but did not receive a final disposition on the transaction. (Verified Mapping = 7)
 * `800`: The supplier has seen this account, but not in the last 6 months. (Verified Mapping = 8)
 * `900`: The supplier has seen this account in the last 6 months. (Verified Mapping = 9)
 * `999`: The supplier has the highest confidence that this account is valid. (Verified Mapping = 10)

status.description:
Verification Status:
  * `1`: Automatic - Payment verification followed Trustly internal rules.
  * `2`: ToVerify	- Payment transaction is held (status = OnHold) for further investigation and approval by the merchant.
  * `3`: Verified - Payment was verified and approved by the merchant or Trustly (see Verification Mode).
  * `4`: Refused - Payment was denied by the merchant or Trustly after verification.

  * `2`: ApprovedByMerchant
  * `3`: VerifiedByTrustly
  * `4`: AmountAuthorizedByMerchant
